chunks: And with this chain, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), that he said:

I saw the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) say the Takbir five times over Hamza, and he said the Takbir five times for each of the martyrs after Hamza, so Hamza was reached by seventy Takbirs.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَاتٍ: Takbirs (plural of saying 'Allahu Akbar'), ritual utterances in prayer
key_terms.حَمْزَةَ: Hamza, the uncle of the Prophet and a prominent martyr of Islam

ai.seo_question: How many Takbirs did the Prophet say for Hamza during his funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the unique honor bestowed upon Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's uncle and 'Lion of God,' by distinguishing his funeral prayer with a specific count of Takbirs. The total of seventy Takbirs—five for Hamza and sixty-five for the subsequent martyrs—underscores his preeminent status among the early martyrs in Shia tradition. This practice reflects the scholarly understanding of Hamza's distinct spiritual rank and his pivotal role in the early consolidation of Islam.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-167 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.), “

I saw the Prophet (S) say God is the Greatest five times over the body of Hamza. Then he said it five times for each of the other martyrs. On the whole, the Prophet (S) had said it seventy times over the body of Hamza.”
